package.description: The root package provisioned to the tag from which the documentation was generated.

serverVersion.description: The version of the server when the documentation was generated.

kind.description: The type object being commented on.

path.description:
The full path down to the object being commented on.
This, in conjunction with the kind, should allow global resolution of the source object.

url.description: The URL against which the documentation was viewed.

username.description: The user name (email address) of the commenter.

title: Feedback on a piece of documentation from someone reading it.
name: DocumentationFeedback
